project_identity.name: VI Archive — The Leonida Files
project_identity.theme_type: Hybrid GTA VI HUD + Cinematic Editorial Research Archive
project_identity.mission: Elevate VI Archive into a top-tier, dark-mode worldwide GTA VI knowledge platform. Transform small, illegible typography and cramped whitespace into a high-impact, tactical research interface with Vice City neon accents (Cyan & Pink) and crisp editorial legibility.

design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Pair tactical game UI/HUD framing (cyan lines, micro crosshairs, corner brackets) with sleek editorial magazine typography (Unbounded + IBM Plex Sans).
Content is King & Legibility First: Eliminate 7-10px micro-fonts for core content. All body text must be 13-15px, micro-labels 11-12px, and headings bold and commanding (up to 48px).
High-Contrast Surface Strategy: Use Dark Obsidian (#08090E) for background, Dark Slate (#12141D) for elevated surfaces, and 1px crisp borders (#222636) with subtle inner glows.
Dynamic Vice Palette: Anchor in dark carbon, elevated by Vice Electric Pink (#FF2A85), Tactical Cyan (#00F0FF), Vice Sunset Gold (#FFB800), and Verification Emerald (#00FF9D).
Preserve All Functional Contracts: Retain 100% of existing data-testid attributes, route structures, search autocomplete behaviors, local bookmarks, and editorial workflows.

type_scale.label_hud: 11px sm:12px | font-weight: 600 | tracking-wider | text-transform: uppercase | font-family: 'JetBrains Mono'

anti_pattern_fixes: REPLACE all 7px, 8px, 9px, and 10px fonts with a minimum 11px label font and 13px body font.
Ensure heading contrast ratio exceeds 7:1 against dark backgrounds and body copy exceeds 4.5:1.

visual_enhancers.hud_brackets: Use pseudo-elements (before/after) or 1px SVG corner brackets on active cards and callout boxes to deliver an authentic GTA VI tactical research HUD feel.
visual_enhancers.scanline_texture: Subtle background scanline effect via repeating linear gradient: linear-gradient(rgba(18,20,29,0) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 50%) with background-size 100% 4px on hero banners.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlays: Multi-stage gradient overlay: linear-gradient(90deg, #08090E 0%, rgba(8,9,14,0.85) 45%, rgba(8,9,14,0.3) 100%), linear-gradient(0deg, #08090E 0%, transparent 50%).
visual_enhancers.interactive_effects: Cards transition with transform: translateY(-3px), border-color: #00F0FF, and shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,240,255,0.12). Buttons scale down slightly on press (:active).

sidebar.navigation: Clear 14px navigation links with left neon indicator bar when active, count badge for 'Guardar', and HUD status footer.

topbar.features: Search autocomplete dropdown with image previews, keyboard shortcut indicator [K], language tag, and bookmarks shortcut.

explore_page.hero_banner: Full width 380px height hero with Vice City sunset backdrop, punchy 44px title ('ARQUIVO MUNDIAL GTA VI'), subheadline, and high-visibility neon search input.
explore_page.category_grid: 4-column responsive bento cards with cyan HUD icons, category title (14px), and claim count indicator.
explore_page.entity_grid: 4-column grid on desktop, 2-col on tablet, 1-col on mobile. EntityCard features 16:9 framed media with map/character badge, bookmark button, 13px summary, and verification tag.

entity_detail.header: 380px tall full-bleed hero with entity key art, back navigation, bookmark/share CTA, title (36px), and summary.
entity_detail.body: Split view: main assertion list (claims with source badges, evidence trigger button) + sticky context sidebar (origin, nature, verification status).

find_search_page.toolbar: Unified search input + type filter pill bar (Todos, Personagens, Locais) + origin filter dropdown + view toggle (Grid / List).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT break existing API endpoints, React router state, or TypeScript typings.
MUST retain all data-testid attributes listed in the preservation checklist.
Refactor App.css and refinements.css to apply the new typography scale and color system.
Use micro-animations (hover transitions 0.2s, subtle lifts) across all interactive buttons and cards.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness down to 360px screen width without text truncation or overflow.
